reason: While config/initializers/i18n.rb:9 does use send(:include, I18n::Backend::Fallbacks), this repository explicitly supports and runs required CI builds on Ruby 2.0.0 (.travis.yml:23, README.md:28). Because Module#include is private in Ruby 2.0.0, calling .include directly would raise NoMethodError, so send(:include, ...) is required rather than a problem.
